safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated meds-002 states Clenil BID but does not include the dose '2 puffs twice daily'.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the exact inhaler dose (2 puffs twice daily) reduces clarity of the patient’s baseline controller regimen, which could lead to incorrect patient instructions or dosing assumptions during an exacerbation review. While not usually immediately dangerous, it can contribute to suboptimal asthma control and additional follow-up.
